title: Worked: solving real quadratics with D < 0

board_content.text: These are the complex cube roots of unity, $\omega$ and $\omega^{2}$.
Both are conjugate pairs — as guaranteed by real coefficients.

segments_english.text: Let's solve a few real-coefficient quadratics where the discriminant turns out negative.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_english.text: Start with the simplest, x squared plus one equals zero. That gives x squared equals minus one, so x is plus or minus i. The two roots that used to be missing.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_english.text: Now x squared plus x plus one equals zero. Compute the discriminant: one minus four, which is minus three, negative.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_english.text: So the roots are minus one plus or minus i root three, all over two.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_english.text: These two numbers are exactly the complex cube roots of unity, omega and omega squared, tying this subtopic back to the polar work.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_english.text: One more, with irrational coefficients: root two x squared plus x plus root two equals zero. The discriminant is one minus four times root two times root two, which is one minus eight, minus seven.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_english.text: So the roots are minus one plus or minus i root seven, all over two root two.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_english.text: In both problems the roots came out as conjugate pairs, exactly as the conjugate-root theorem guarantees whenever the coefficients are real.
segments_english.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: Kuch real-coefficient quadratics solve karte hain jahan discriminant negative nikalta hai.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: Sabse simple se shuru karo, x squared plus one equals zero. Ye deta hai x squared barabar minus one, to x hai plus or minus i. Wahi do roots jo pehle missing the.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: Ab x squared plus x plus one equals zero. Discriminant compute karo: one minus four, jo hai minus three, negative.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: To roots hain minus one plus or minus i root three, poora over two.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: Ye do numbers bilkul complex cube roots of unity hain, omega aur omega squared, is subtopic ko polar work se jodte hue.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: Ek aur, irrational coefficients ke saath: root two x squared plus x plus root two equals zero. Discriminant hai one minus four times root two times root two, jo hai one minus eight, minus seven.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: To roots hain minus one plus or minus i root seven, poora over two root two.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.

segments_hinglish.text: Dono problems mein roots conjugate pairs nikle, bilkul jaisa conjugate-root theorem guarantee karta hai jab bhi coefficients real hon.
segments_hinglish.tts_description: a warm 30s female hindi accent voice, conversational pacing, neutral register, elearning_instructor.
